title: "Biomass analysis"
output: pdf_document

```{r, message=FALSE}

rm(list=ls())
library(data.table)   # fread
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)          # datatable output
library(scales)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(plotly)


N_BOOT_REP = 50

# learning_curve_csv = "01_runs/regression_resnet101/2025-11-20_10-59-32/epoch_results.csv"
# total_lines <- R.utils::countLines(learning_curve_csv)
# learning_curve <- fread(learning_curve_csv, nrows = total_lines - 2)

md_csv = "predictions.csv"
metadata <- fread(md_csv)

metadata = metadata[IS_VALID == TRUE]
metadata[, DRYMASS_MG_PRED := (BF_PRED*ROI_SIZE_MM)^3 ]
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG := DRYMASS_MG^ (1/3)]
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED := DRYMASS_MG_PRED^ (1/3)]
metadata[, sqrtAREA_MM := AREA_MM2^(1/2)]
```

## Data overview

``` {r, message=FALSE}
ggplot(metadata, aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, sqrtAREA_MM, shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + 
    geom_point(alpha=.3)  + 
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") 
    

ggplot(metadata, aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, sqrtAREA_MM, shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + 
    geom_point(alpha=.6)  + 
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    facet_grid( . ~ SPLIT)
metadata[, .N, by=c("DATASET", "SPLIT")]
```
## Area-based biomass prediction
```{r, message=FALSE}
area_model <- lm(cbrDRYMASS_MG ~ sqrtAREA_MM, metadata[SPLIT == "train"])
# area_model <- lmer(cbrDRYMASS_MG ~ sqrtAREA_MM + (1 | INSECT_ID),
#                    data = metadata[SPLIT == "train"])
summary(area_model)
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM := predict(area_model, metadata, allow.new.levels = TRUE)]
lims <- range(c(metadata$cbrDRYMASS_MG, metadata$cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM))
ggplot(metadata[SPLIT == "test"],
       aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, 
           cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM, 
           shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) +
  geom_point(alpha=.6) + geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = lims, ylim = lims)


summary_dt = rbindlist(
    lapply(1:N_BOOT_REP,
        function(x) {
          subset = metadata[SPLIT == "test"] [ ,.SD[sample(1:.N, 1),], by="INSECT_ID"]
          subset = subset[sample(1:.N,.N, replace=T)]
          out = subset[, .(cbrDRYMASS_MG,cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM, DATASET)]
          out[, REP := x]
          }
        )
)

performance_rep = summary_dt[, 
             .(
               MAE = mean(abs(cbrDRYMASS_MG-cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM)),
               R2 = summary(lm(cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM ~ cbrDRYMASS_MG))$r.squared
               )
           ,
           by=c("REP", "DATASET")]

performance_rep[,.(MAE = mean(MAE),
                   MAE_conf_l = quantile(MAE, c(0.025)),
                   MAE_conf_h = quantile(MAE, c(0.975)),
                   R2 = mean(R2),
                   R2_conf_l = quantile(R2, c(0.025)),
                   R2_conf_h = quantile(R2, c(0.975))
                   ), by=DATASET]



```
## CNN-based biomass prediction
```{r, message=FALSE}
# 
# ggplot(learning_curve, aes(epoch, train_loss)) + 
#   geom_line(colour="blue") +
#   geom_line(aes(y=val_loss), colour="red")  + 
#   scale_y_continuous(name="loss (train: blue, val: red)")
  
lims <- range(c(metadata$cbrDRYMASS_MG, metadata$cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED))
ggplot(metadata[SPLIT == "test"], 
       aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, 
           cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED, 
           shape=DATASET, 
           colour=DATASET)) +
  geom_point(alpha=.6) + 
  geom_smooth(aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED), colour="black", fill="black",  inherit.aes = FALSE, method = "lm") + 
  coord_fixed(xlim = lims, ylim = lims)


summary_dt = rbindlist(
    lapply(1:N_BOOT_REP,
        function(x) {
          subset = metadata[SPLIT == "test"] [ ,.SD[sample(1:.N, 1),], by="INSECT_ID"]
          subset = subset[sample(1:.N,.N, replace=T)]
          out = subset[, .(cbrDRYMASS_MG,cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED, DATASET)]
          out[, REP := x]
          }
        )
)

performance_rep = summary_dt[, 
             .(
               MAE = mean(abs(cbrDRYMASS_MG-cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED)),
               R2 = summary(lm(cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED ~ cbrDRYMASS_MG))$r.squared
               )
           ,
           by=c("REP", "DATASET")]

performance_rep[,.(MAE = mean(MAE),
                   MAE_conf_l = quantile(MAE, c(0.025)),
                   MAE_conf_h = quantile(MAE, c(0.975)),
                   R2 = mean(R2),
                   R2_conf_l = quantile(R2, c(0.025)),
                   R2_conf_h = quantile(R2, c(0.975))
                   ), by=DATASET]

# summary(mod)
```

ggplot(metadata[SPLIT == "test" & NOTES=="droso"],

  geom_point(alpha=.6) + 
  geom_smooth(aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM), colour="black", fill="black",  inherit.aes = FALSE, method = "lm") +
